name: @local/vbw-host
description: VBW host plugin: registers vbw_* tools (ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))) that proxy over loopback HTTP to the local VBW broker; discovers the broker via _vbw/state/broker.json and spawns it when missing and autoSpawn is on. No hard npm dependencies: node builtins only, @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools is reused when resolvable with a local defineTool replica as fallback.
